Herb Garden at Newton University
Two years ago, Newton students established a campus
herb garden to promote sustainable agriculture. The once
tiny plot now includes over eighty herbs, including hyssop,
sorrel, and goldenseal.
Students lead workshops and demonstrate eco-friendly
gardening, making this a unique educational tool for
the university.
